notes.subject: עלילה
notes.rationale: 'exploit/deed' (from עלל, to do repeatedly) — rendered as 'deeds' vs KJV 'works'; some read it as 'unseemly act'.

notes.subject: bel
notes.rationale: לב rendered 'bel' (feelings/will), not body organ 'hat', per D4.

notes.subject: man longlong
notes.rationale: the verse portrays the fool's inner speech, a summons to the reader to see.

translation: Long man i lukautim singsing, bilong David. Man longlong i tok long bel bilong en: i no gat Elohim. Ol i bagarapim olgeta, ol i wokim ol samting we ol i bihainim long en olsem nogut tru; i no gat wanpela i wokim gutpela samting.

tokens.gloss: ol i wokim ol samting nogut tru
ol samting we ol i bihainim long en
